unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not reach the service. Nothing is wrong on your side. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

notFound.title: Salon not found
notFound.body: There is no salon at this address. Check the address and try again.

unavailable.title: Temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: This salon's site is not available at the moment. Please try again later.

account.signInHelp: Sign in to your salon workspace.
account.secureTeam: Secure access for your salon team
account.passwordHelp: For help accessing your account, contact your salon administrator. Password recovery is not available online.
account.menuHelp: Choose a page of the staff workspace.
account.codeHelp: Enter the current six-digit code from your authenticator app.
account.wait: Please wait {seconds} seconds before trying again.
account.mfaHelp: Add this setup key to your authenticator app, then enter its six-digit code.
account.conflict: This entry changed. Refresh the list before trying again.
account.confirmRemoval: Remove this staff account? Their access ends immediately.
account.professionalGrant: Allow this Professional to see the salon calendar, customers and figures
account.empty: There are no entries to show.
account.denied: You do not have permission to view this page.
account.signedOut: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
account.browser_unsupported: This browser cannot safely coordinate account access across tabs. Use an up-to-date browser to sign in or change device access.
account.service_unavailable: We could not reach the service. Your entries are kept. Please try again.
account.invalid_credentials: The sign-in details did not match. Check them and try again.
account.invalid_code: That code did not work. Check your authenticator app and try again.
account.code_expired: This verification attempt has expired. Sign in again.
account.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
account.bad_request: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
account.permission_denied: You do not have permission for this action.
account.not_found: This entry is no longer available. Refresh the list.
account.invalid_session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
account.mfaNotice: Setup instructions are shown only here. Keep the key private.

console.title: Operator console
console.signInHelp: Sign in with your operator account. Every operator completes two-step verification.
console.mfaEnrollHelp: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
console.mfaVerifyHelp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
console.mfaNotice: This setup key is shown only now. Do not share it, and do not save it anywhere except your authenticator app.
console.denied: Your operator account cannot manage salons or plans. Sign out, or ask an administrator for access.
console.signedOut: Your console session has ended. Sign in again.
console.searchSalonsHelp: Search by salon name or web address.
console.searchPlansHelp: Search by plan name or key.
console.total: {total, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
console.salonsEmptyHelp: Create the first salon with its Owner and plan.
console.plansEmptyHelp: Define a plan before you create a salon.
console.slugHelp: 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The salon is reached at {example}.
console.countryHelp: Two-letter ISO code, for example LK.
console.currencyHelp: Three-letter ISO code, for example LKR.
console.timeZoneHelp: An IANA time zone, for example Asia/Colombo.
console.contactPhoneHelp: A Sri Lankan mobile number, for example 077 123 4567.
console.noPlansToChoose: Create a plan first; a salon needs one.
console.ownerPasswordHelp: 15 to 128 characters. Share it with the Owner privately; it is never shown again.
console.ownerNext: Next: the Owner signs in at {url} with the initial password and sets up two-step verification.
console.planKeyHelp: 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later.
console.immutable: A plan never changes after it is created. Define a new plan for different limits.
console.detailsUnavailable: This record could not be found.
console.uncertain: The console could not confirm whether this was saved. Try again: the same request is sent, so nothing is created twice.
console.service_unavailable: The console cannot reach the service right now. Try again in a moment.
console.invalid_credentials: The email, password or code was not accepted.
console.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
console.invalid_session: Your console session has ended. Sign in again.
console.permission_denied: Your operator account cannot do this.
console.not_found: This record could not be found.
console.slug_taken: Another salon already uses this web address.
console.plan_key_taken: Another plan already uses this key.
console.idempotency_conflict: This request was already used for different details. Review and submit again.
console.request_rejected: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
console.browser_unsupported: This browser cannot keep console sessions safe across tabs. Use a current browser to sign in or out.
